scope: Formal obtainable source heroes, grouped only by existing character-groups origins. No accepted character assets/runtime/browser changes.

rules.formalHero: Playable == true AND SummonCategory not null/None AND nonempty BattleClass
rules.identity: Use native OriginId. Only existing source-backed group.origins merge identities; knight[1,2], peimei[52,53]. Never merge by full display name.
rules.nativePresence: Recover OriginId by exact heroClasses keys joined to Hero.Name; heroOrigins is not part of these native packages.
rules.rank: sourceMinimumRank preserves native zero-based Hero.Rank (0 is normal starting rank); not an inferred rarity label.
rules.completion: Presence, compiler match, source mechanism coverage, production state and user acceptance are independent. None is automatically promoted.
rules.probe: Compiler matches and source/member/consumption candidates are planning evidence only. Native type members do not prove IStamina or consumption; MagazineSize alone does not create a magazine.
rules.baseline: 128 is the fixed new-production backlog relative to 44-package/43-group batch-start snapshot. New files never silently reduce it.
